set.tovw: Convict's claim; island unnamed; a 1934-35 plane party may have taken it

tw-mn-turtle-lake-marcell-brunette.st: The Minneapolis Journal (22 Jul 1935) has the cache as a thermos bottle set in concrete and says settlers recalled that in winter 1934-35 an airplane swooped about Turtle Lake and men dug into the deep snow and dragged off a heavy object. No outcome reported 1936-65.
tw-mn-turtle-lake-marcell-brunette.t: Islands are look-only until ownership is checked.

set.tovw: Shack searched Feb 1915, nothing found; money was in banks
set.st: James Kehoe, a recluse of nearly 40 years in Bloomington Twp, died in Jan 1915 leaving $2,000 in two banks. His brother William and the town clerk ransacked his shack for a hidden fortune and found nothing. No telling has any burial claim. Pin is approximate, not the spot itself. Independent listing: Bloomington (MN gazetteer 1888: place, 9 listings).

src: Minneapolis Journal, 1 Feb 1915, p. 2 'Hunt For Hidden Fortune Fails' (newspapers.com 811205084)
